subject: W7 credential producer has a source, so the System pane can be fed
result: Investigated the W7 finding in #282 that disclose_credential_world and with_credential_world have no production call site, leaving the System pane permanently reading not attempted for this world. The missing producer has two halves and both already exist, so this is wiring of the same shape as W6, not a new capability. Requirements: ContextResolution.model_routes (Vec<ModelRouteSet>) already carries CredentialCondition::Required{hint} and Satisfied{hint,binding_ref} per declared route, joined into the resolution by Service::join_model_routes in aikit-cli/src/app/mod.rs around line 805. A worlds credential needs are exactly the credentials its resolved Model routes require, which is a defensible derivation rather than an invented one; the pure part belongs in aikit-core beside disclose_credential_world. Roster: aikit-cli/src/credential.rs already builds NativeSecureStoreProvider and EnvironmentImportProvider and calls resolve_registered_credential, but only per explicit CredentialRequest from the command line; a world level roster observation reuses the same providers. Seam: project_world() in aikit-tui/src/project_world_service.rs already attaches versioned_world from a PaletteBackend method and warns when observation fails; a credential_world() backend method attached through with_credential_world is the identical pattern, and the CLI Service is the caller that can observe. Not started. Deliberately stopped rather than opening a fifth unmerged PR: 279, 280, 281 and 284 are all green and awaiting the owner, so the constraint on this programme is merge decisions, not implementation throughput.
